notes.title: 2 Express Killer OST tracks launched in Rock Album
notes.content:
You played the game and saw the band at the station? Did you know they are a real band' Did you also noticed that they play a rock song at the station (if you pay them) and that there is a rock song at the end credits and both these songs are from the same band?!?

YOU DID?!
Cool, mister "know-it-all". But we bet you didn't know they just launched an Album with these 2 songs and more on iTunes, Spotify and more, called "Old Dogs" from "Gordo e os Indecentes".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837640/fb42c02af3a0e117d18fec151ba0de9f1858a1d6.jpg[/img]

That's right, you can now hear some cool 80's rock, just like Detective Case would hear (back in the 80's) by checking out "Gordo e os Indecentes" latest album, "Old Dogs". And, if you live in Portugal, you can even buy it in physical format! Just in time for the hollidays?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837640/c4794a940cb8b467bddee6b78c91f9d3d7fbe5db.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to 1.1 / Story upgrade
notes.content:
The Express Killer story is now a bit better!
There were a few tidbits of the main story that we thought could be just a little bit better, so we went back and fine tuned it.

We hope everyone has been enjoying this sequel. We see on our data that a lot of fans have finished the game but the number of reviews is really low. If you have some free time please drop as a line or two and let us know how you liked the game :)

Thanks!
Filipe

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Quick update with some quick fixes is out.
- Solved a problem with the Trophy "One Down" not popping up
- Fixed the overlap of the credits in English
- Fixed some small pixel-art problems
- Corrected typos and errors

If you are still having trouble getting the game to run on a Mac, go here.
https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/1/828939163943652381/

notes.title: Trailer and launch date incoming!
notes.content:
Hey there friends, colleagues and fans.
Development has been coming along nicely. Having had the time to post much but I always rather spend time on the game than just posting for the sake of posting.

Anyway, the game has been approved by our good friends here at Valve so we are basically all thumbs up for release. This doesn't mean we are finished and ready to go, it just means the basic things like achievements, controller support, correct installation on Windows, Mac and Linux is all tested and working. There is still a final stretch to go.

Meawhile I am wrapping up our trailer with some final editing and tune-ups.
We should release it next week during E3 and in it we will announce our release date.

Anyway, stay tuna! (this is a terrible joke/pun but I love it)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837640/0a1f3b23ba28dfcb90c16949baac6c27c4b95aca.jpg[/img]
